SELF_HELP_STOP.findingAsWritten: The committed legal-design record holds eight selfHelpStopConditions for track nh_petition_nonconviction_pre2019 and none of the eight reached the packet - 0 of 8, against the comparative controls the verifier cited at IN 13/13, RI 5/5 and TX 7/7. participant-instructions.md had no stop section at all.

All eight are printed word for word, as a list, in a new 'Where self-help ends' section of participant-instructions.md, in the shape the Indiana and Rhode Island families use. Four are then restated with their consequence, because they cost money or they mislead: the RSA 651:5, IV three-year bar on a further petition, that the annulment is not recognised federally or for immigration, that RSA 651:5, XVII does not oblige a private background-check database to remove the record, and that annulment does not restore firearm rights.

SELF_HELP_STOP.aResourceWasNotInvented: The section names a lawyer licensed in New Hampshire and the clerk of the court for procedural questions, and states in terms that it names no legal-aid organisation or referral line because the platform holds no sourced New Hampshire directory - the same reasoning the packet already gives for printing no courthouse address.
